en:
WARNING: This game includes flashing that may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. 

“gather round little chickadees, and let me spin you a yarn…” 

Oh hello, dearie. You are a little old lady who needs to clean your big magical cellar. 

Learn colorful spells that change the way you move and interact. Solve mind-bending puzzles, or just hit stuff with your broom.  

The only way to stop the decay of the world is by tidying up. 

- Tidy up! Sweep away dust, monsters, frogs and more with your trusty broom.
- Wield colorful hag magic to navigate the glitch dungeon.
- Free the elders trapped in the crystals. Stop the decay of the world
- Be a Babushka!!!
zh_CN:
警告：本游戏包含闪光，可能会引发光敏性癫痫患者的癫痫发作。

“小朋友们，快过来，我来给你们讲个故事......” 

哦，你好哇。你是一位老太太，今天要来打扫你的魔法大地窖。

你可以学习不同的咒语获得新技能，也可以直接抡起扫帚。 

清理打扫是能阻止世界衰败的唯一方法。

- 整理！用你的老朋友扫帚扫走灰尘、怪物、青蛙...
- 施展多种巫婆魔法，在故障地牢中穿梭。
- 释放被困在水晶中的长老。阻止世界的衰败。
- 做一个疯狂老奶！
